# Ace Office Pods by Ace Workplace Solutions

> Ace Office Pods (ACE WORKPLACE SOLUTIONS, SSM 202403171118) supplies acoustic
> office pods, office booths, office phone booths, and meeting pods in Malaysia.
> Showroom in Klang, Selangor (by appointment). Delivery and installation across
> Malaysia — Klang Valley, Petaling Jaya, Damansara, Kuala Lumpur, Penang,
> Johor Bahru, and nationwide.

## Products

- [Ace Uno](/pods/ace-uno): Freestanding, enclosed 1-person acoustic call and focus pod for calls, video meetings, and focused work. RM8,850 pod only; no published dB rating.
- [Ace Plus](/pods/ace-plus): 1-person phone and focus pod. Ace publishes an unverified first-party approximately 27 dB(A) claim for Plus; no verified supporting test document has been provided. From RM14,500.
- [Ace Flex](/pods/ace-flex): Spacious 1-person focus pod. From RM19,900.
- [Ace Flex Duo](/pods/ace-flex-duo): 2-person focus and discussion pod. From RM23,900.
- [Ace Meet](/pods/ace-meet): 2–4 pax meeting pod for small team collaboration. From RM22,200.
- [Ace Hub](/pods/ace-hub): Up to 6 pax hub and lounge pod. From RM27,800.

## Key facts

- Acoustic performance: model-specific; only Ace Plus has an unverified first-party approximately 27 dB(A) claim, and no verified supporting test document has been provided
- No published dB rating: Ace Uno, Ace Flex, Ace Flex Duo, Ace Meet, and Ace Hub
- Showroom: Jalan Gopeng, Kawasan 18, 41400 Klang, Selangor
- Phone / WhatsApp: +601154352700
- Email: sales@aceofficepods.com
